title: 第15章 离去
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
就算在21世纪有人说他来自未来，人们也会当他是神经病，更何况是处在封建社会的明朝。
“不瞒殿下，在下方才所说都是真的，都是殿下要经历的事情！”陈浩感慨道。
“先生若是责怪小王先前的无理就请明说，何必继续编故事戏弄小王！”朱由检无奈的说道，心中也并未生气，刘备请诸葛亮还三顾茅庐呢！他被高人戏弄一下也可以忍受得住！
陈浩笑了笑，道：“殿下还是不信？”
朱由检点了点头，摆明了自己的观点。
“既如此，在下和殿下打个赌如何？”陈浩道。
朱由检好奇的问道：“先生想和小王打什么赌？”
陈浩说道：“呵呵，殿下信不信在下能从你眼前直接消失？”
“小王不信！”朱由检还是认定陈浩在戏弄他。
“那在下就给殿下演示一次，但是在演示之前在下想见一面堂兄沈炼。”陈浩道。
“好啊，先生随意，先生就将这里当成自己的家，无人敢阻拦先生。”朱由检欣然同意，他倒是要看看他陈浩搞的什么鬼。
“那就谢过殿下了！”陈浩冲朱由检行了个抱拳礼，便开门走出了屋外。
待走出屋门，陈浩却见只有丁白缨一人在不远处站着，遂问道：“我大哥哪去了？”
“茅厕！”丁白缨依旧保持着冷冰冰的态度。
朱由检这时也走了出来，见丁白缨对陈浩态度恶劣，开口训斥道：“白缨怎么跟先生说话呢？从现在起，你们见先生要像见本王一样。”
什么？丁白缨怀疑自己的耳朵听错了，但是看到朱由检认真的表情，丁白缨还是说了声：“是!”
可惜朱由检收买人心的举动注定是要失败了，陈浩可不会因为他良好的态度而留下。
“殿下能不能给在下找一间屋子，我有几句话想跟堂兄说。”陈浩道。
“白缨快去给先生安排！”
朱由检给丁白缨下达了命令，然后对陈浩道：“先生请！”

陈浩点了下头，便跟在了丁白缨身后，不多时丁白缨将他领入了一间屋子。
这间屋子比刚才那间稍小了一些，屋内更是空荡荡的连张桌子都没有。
将陈浩领进屋子后，丁白缨就离开了，态度并不比之前好多少。
蹬蹬蹬蹬！
两三分钟后，一阵急促的脚步声传进了陈浩耳中，陈浩不用想便知道是沈炼。
“唉！这肚子实在是不争气！”
果然，片刻后沈炼有些尴尬的走进了屋，而后问道：“你和殿下谈的怎么样了？”
陈浩笑道：“我和殿下谈的很好，他不光答应了放过咱们兄弟，还安排我去广州为他办事。”
陈浩不想将穿越这种事弄得人尽皆知，况且沈炼还是原主人的堂兄，这件事他只告诉朱由检一个人就够了，于是他准备给沈炼编段瞎话。
“真的，那太好了！”沈炼先是一脸喜意，但随即又担心道：“殿下只派你一人前去，没有安排为兄吗？”
陈浩知道沈炼这是在担心他，旋即解释道：“殿下是派我从广州出海跟洋人购买那种火器，你不懂这里面的东西，所以殿下才没安排你！”
沈炼自然知道堂弟身上那件火器的威力，以那件火器的来源换兄弟二人一条活路很合适。
“几时能够回来？”沈炼又问道。
陈浩道：“少则三五年吧，多则可能十来年，殿下不可能只买一回火器，我可能会在西洋驻留。”陈浩都不知道还能不能回到这方世界，为了不让沈炼担心，只得尽量将归期拖后。
“那么久吗？”沈炼皱眉道。
陈浩笑道：“呵呵，大哥莫要担心我，我对西洋的情况比京城还熟悉呢。”
“唉！”沈炼抬手重重的拍了下陈浩的肩膀，感慨道：“你我兄弟十年未见，只不过相聚了十几天，今日你又要离去，再见不知是何年啊！”
陈浩从沈炼身上感受到了浓浓的亲情，这是他在地球没有感受过的，深深触动了他的内心，但是他必须要离去，前路坎坷，这里不是他的终点！
“殿下对火器赶得急，要我今日便启程，大哥保重!”陈浩跟沈炼做了最后的告别。
“这么急吗？”沈炼有些怀疑。

陈浩只得解释道：“魏阉步步紧逼，眼下的情况刻不容缓！”
唉！沈炼再次叹息了一声，然后郑重的跟陈浩说道：“保重！”
“大哥也保重！”陈浩同样抱拳道，说罢，陈浩便走出了这间屋子。

content_en:
Even if someone in the 21st century said that he came from the future, people would still think of him as crazy, let alone the Ming Dynasty in a feudal society.
"To be fair to Your Highness, what I said below are all true, and they are all things that Your Highness has to go through!" Chen Hao said with emotion.
"Sir, if you blame Xiao Wang for being unreasonable before, please say it clearly. Why continue to make up stories to tease Xiao Wang!" Zhu Youjian said helplessly, not angry at all. Liu Bei asked Zhuge Liang to visit the thatched cottage! He can tolerate being teased by an expert!
Chen Hao smiled and said, "Your Highness, you still don't believe it?"
Zhu Youjian nodded and made his point clear.
"In that case, how about making a bet with His Highness?" Chen Hao said.
Zhu Youjian asked curiously: "What bet do you want to make with Xiao Wang?"
Chen Hao said: "Haha, your highness, do you believe that I can disappear directly from your eyes?"
"Xiao Wang doesn't believe it!" Zhu Youjian still believed that Chen Hao was teasing him.
"Then I will demonstrate it to His Highness, but before I demonstrate it, I would like to meet my cousin Shen Lian." Chen Hao said.
"Okay, sir, you can treat this place as your own home. No one dares to stop you." Zhu Youjian readily agreed, but he wanted to see what he, Chen Hao, was up to.
"Then thank you, Your Highness!" Chen Hao gave Zhu Youjian a fist salute, then opened the door and walked out of the house.
When he walked out of the house, Chen Hao saw only Ding Baiying standing not far away, and asked, "Where is my elder brother?"
"Toilet!" Ding Baiying still maintained a cold attitude.
Zhu Youjian also walked out at this time. Seeing Ding Baiying's bad attitude towards Chen Hao, he reprimanded: "How can Baiying talk to Mr. Bai Ying? From now on, you must treat Mr. Bai as you see me."
What? Ding Baiying suspected that her ears had heard it wrong, but seeing Zhu Youjian's serious expression, Ding Baiying still said: "Yes!"
It's a pity that Zhu Youjian's move to win people's hearts is destined to fail, and Chen Hao will not stay because of his good attitude.
"Your Highness, can you find me a room? I have a few words to say to my cousin." Chen Hao said.
"Bai Ying, go and make arrangements for sir!"
Zhu Youjian gave the order to Ding Baiying, and then said to Chen Hao: "Sir, please!"
Chen Hao nodded and followed Ding Baiying. Soon Ding Baiying led him into a room.
This room is slightly smaller than the one just now, and it is even more empty without a table.
After leading Chen Hao into the house, Ding Baiying left, his attitude not much better than before.
Kick, kick, kick!
Two or three minutes later, a burst of rapid footsteps reached Chen Hao's ears. Chen Hao knew it was Shen Lian without even thinking.
"Oh! This belly is really disappointing!"
Sure enough, after a while, Shen Lian walked into the room with some embarrassment, and then asked: "How was your conversation with His Highness?"
Chen Hao smiled and said: "His Highness and I had a good conversation. Not only did he agree to let our brothers go, he also arranged for me to go to Guangzhou to work for him."
Chen Hao didn't want everyone to know about time travel. Besides, Shen Lian was the cousin of the original owner. It was enough for him to tell Zhu Youjian about this matter, so he was going to make up some lies for Shen Lian.
"Really, that's great!" Shen Lian looked happy at first, but then worried: "His Highness only sent you alone, didn't he arrange to be my brother?"
Chen Hao knew that Shen Lian was worried about him, so he immediately explained: "His Highness sent me to go to sea from Guangzhou to buy that kind of firearms from foreigners. You don't understand what's involved, so His Highness didn't arrange it for you!"
Shen Lian naturally knew the power of the firearm on his cousin, so it was appropriate for the two brothers to trade the source of the firearm for a way out.
"When can I come back?" Shen Lian asked again.
Chen Hao said: "It can take as little as three to five years, or as many as ten years. Your Highness can't just buy firearms once. I may stay in the West." Chen Hao didn't know if he could come back here.Fang Shijie, in order not to worry Shen Lian, had no choice but to postpone his return date as much as possible.
"So long?" Shen Lian frowned.
Chen Hao smiled and said: "Haha, brother, don't worry about me. I am more familiar with the situation in the West than in the capital."
"Alas!" Shen Lian raised his hand and patted Chen Hao's shoulder heavily, and said with emotion: "You and I have not seen each other for ten years, but we have only been together for more than ten days. Today you are leaving again. I don't know when we will see each other again!"
Chen Hao felt a strong sense of family affection from Shen Lian, something he had never felt on earth, and it deeply touched his heart. But he had to leave. The road ahead was bumpy, and this was not his end!
"Your Highness is in a hurry for firearms and asked me to set off today. Take care, brother!" Chen Hao said his final farewell to Shen Lian.
"Are you in such a hurry?" Shen Lian was a little doubtful.
Chen Hao could only explain: "Wei Qian is pressing forward step by step. The current situation is urgent!"
Alas! Shen Lian sighed again, and then solemnly said to Chen Hao: "Take care!"
"Brother, take care too!" Chen Hao also clasped his fists and said, Chen Hao walked out of the room.
